text: Normalize bundler virtual CSS ids at the adapter boundary so Webpack slash-prefixed decoded ids still reach the NUL-prefixed stylesheet loader.
Keep ecosystem-specific migration policy inside its adapter; use-case orchestration must call adapter hooks instead of checking adapter IDs.
Keep runtime artifact storage, serialization, and mounting behind separate ports; do not let a runtime sheet own DOM lifecycle and CSS rendering in one implementation.
Keep Tailwind code generation pure at the artifact boundary; filesystem writes belong to an injected writer adapter owned by the CLI composition root.
Keep CSS stylesheet state separate from condition parsing and rule serialization; compose those policies through a focused serializer instead of one monolithic createStylesheet module.

Do not compare built-in adapter, source, target, backend, pattern, validator, lowering, or pipeline identities using raw strings; use the owning registry's TypeScript enum and neutral interface metadata.
Keep migration orchestration free of direct Node filesystem effects; inject an owned project-file port and keep source discovery on the shared workspace.
Avoid untyped registry identity literals in tests and orchestration; use the owning TypeScript enum or branded identifier.

Never apply a codemod emission when it reports an unpreserved residual; preserve the source with a typed skip marker, and mark residuals preserved only when a target carrier explicitly retains their semantics.
